_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for Libya covering Phoenician Tripolitania and Cyrenaica, Roman Leptis Magna, Vandal-Byzantine control, Arab conquest, Karamanli dynasty, Ottoman Tripolitania, Italian colonial atrocities, Idris monarchy, Gaddafi's Jamahiriya (1969–2011), Arab Spring uprising, NATO intervention, and post-Gaddafi civil war.

country_profile.government_type: Provisional (rival governments in Tripoli and Tobruk)

ethnic_groups.name: Arab/Arabised Berber
ethnic_groups.notes: Majority Arab or Arabised population; descended from Arab conquests and Bedouin migrations (Banu Hilal 11th century); mixed with indigenous Berbers

ethnic_groups.name: Berber (Amazigh)
ethnic_groups.notes: Distinct Berber-speaking communities; Nafusa Mountains (Jabal Nafusa); Zuwara; Ghadames oasis; Tuareg in Fezzan

ethnic_groups.name: Tuareg
ethnic_groups.notes: Saharan Berbers; southern Libya (Fezzan); nomadic heritage; Gaddafi recruited in military

ethnic_groups.name: Tebu (Toubou)
ethnic_groups.notes: Saharan people; southeastern Libya; Tibesti region; cross-border with Chad; marginalised under Gaddafi

ethnic_groups.name: Sub-Saharan African migrants
ethnic_groups.notes: Significant population from Niger, Chad, Sudan, Nigeria; many in transit to Europe; slave trade legacy

ethnic_groups.name: Other (including Egyptian, Tunisian)
ethnic_groups.notes: North African expatriates; remnants of Greek, Italian, Turkish communities

independence.notes: First country to gain independence through UN

current_leader.name: Mohamed al-Menfi
current_leader.title: Chairman of Presidential Council (Tripoli-based GNU)
current_leader.notes: UN-backed Government of National Unity; rival to HoR in Tobruk

rival_government.name: Aguila Saleh Issa
rival_government.title: Speaker of House of Representatives (Tobruk)
rival_government.notes: Eastern Libya government; backed by Khalifa Haftar's Libyan National Army (LNA)

former_leaders.name: King Idris I
former_leaders.notes: Senussi order leader; first and only king; pro-Western; oil wealth; overthrown by Gaddafi coup

former_leaders.name: Muammar Gaddafi
former_leaders.notes: Colonel; Revolutionary Command Council; Jamahiriya (state of the masses); Green Book; Pan-Arabism/Pan-Africanism; Lockerbie bombing; rapprochement 2003; Arab Spring uprising; NATO intervention; killed October 2011 in Sirte

910.name: Prehistoric Libya
910.description: Saharan rock art; Fezzan cave paintings; Garamantian origins.

sub_clusters.name: Tadrart Acacus Rock Art
sub_clusters.description: UNESCO World Heritage; rock paintings showing green Sahara.

sub_clusters.name: Green Sahara Period
sub_clusters.description: Humid period; pastoralism; lakes in Fezzan.

920.name: Ancient Libya — Garamantes, Greeks, Romans
920.description: Garamantian civilisation, Greek Cyrenaica, Roman Tripolitania, Byzantine era.

sub_clusters.name: Garamantes Civilisation
sub_clusters.description: Saharan irrigation empire in Fezzan; underground foggaras; trans-Saharan trade.

sub_clusters.name: Greek Cyrenaica
sub_clusters.description: Cyrene founded by Thera colonists; Pentapolis; Eratosthenes born here.

sub_clusters.name: Roman Tripolitania and Cyrenaica
sub_clusters.description: Leptis Magna (Septimius Severus' birthplace); Sabratha; prosperous provinces.

920.name: Islamic Libya
920.description: Arab conquest; various dynasties; trans-Saharan trade.

sub_clusters.name: Arab Conquest
sub_clusters.description: Amr ibn al-As; Berber Islamisation; decline of ancient cities.

sub_clusters.name: Medieval Dynasties
sub_clusters.description: Aghlabids, Fatimids, Hafsids control parts of Libya; Fezzan trade routes.

930.name: Ottoman Libya
930.description: Tripoli Regency; Karamanli dynasty; Barbary Wars; Senussi order.

sub_clusters.name: Tripoli Regency
sub_clusters.description: Ottoman Tripolitania; corsair economy; rivalry with Malta and European navies.

sub_clusters.name: Karamanli Dynasty
sub_clusters.description: Semi-autonomous dynasty; First Barbary War with US; shores of Tripoli.

sub_clusters.name: Senussi Order
sub_clusters.description: Sufi-Islamic revivalist order in Cyrenaica; resistance to colonisation.

940.name: Italian Colonisation
940.description: Italo-Turkish War; brutal pacification; concentration camps; WWII theatre.

sub_clusters.name: Italo-Turkish War
sub_clusters.description: Italy invades; Ottoman cession; resistance continues.

sub_clusters.name: Omar Mukhtar Resistance
sub_clusters.description: Lion of the Desert; 20-year guerrilla war; Italian genocide kills ~100,000 Libyans.

sub_clusters.name: WWII — North African Campaign
sub_clusters.description: Desert Fox Rommel; Tobruk; El Alamein; Allied liberation.

sub_clusters.name: Kingdom of Libya
sub_clusters.description: King Idris I; federal then unitary monarchy; oil discovered 1959; rapid modernisation.

950.name: Gaddafi Revolution
950.description: Muammar Gaddafi coup; Green Book; Jamahiriya; state sponsor of terrorism.

sub_clusters.name: State-Sponsored Terrorism

960.name: Libyan Civil Wars
